Issue: AI highlighted the broad line 30 permit ip any any rule. Proper insertion of sequence 25 deny ACE was validated.
Human Correction: Modify ACL 101 to insert line 25 denying traffic from 192.168.50.0/24 to 10.0.0.0/8 before the permit statement.

Issue: Accurately recognized DHCP relay requirement across routed boundaries.

Issue: AI correctly recognized Layer 7 DNS failure given successful raw IP ping.
Human Correction: Update the DHCP pool on R1 to point to valid DNS server (e.g. 8.8.8.8 10.0.0.53) with "dns-server 8.8.8.8". Renew DHCP leases on clients.

Issue: RESPONSIBLE AI AUDIT: The AI hallucinated that the interface needed "no shutdown". On Cisco switches, assigning an access port to an uncreated VLAN shows port status "inactive", not "disabled/shutdown". Human review caught this fundamental Cisco nuance.
Human Correction: Create VLAN 20 in global configuration mode: "vlan 20" and name it "Finance".

Issue: Straightforward Layer 1 administrative down check. Accurate fix.
Human Correction: Access interface Serial0/0/0 on R1 and execute the "no shutdown" command.

Issue: Accurately cross-referenced syslog DUPADDR with MAC address table to isolate port Fa0/14.
Human Correction: Locate device on SW1 port Fa0/14 and reconfigure it to use DHCP or an unused static IP (e.g. 192.168.1.250).

Issue: RESPONSIBLE AI AUDIT: The AI suggested "no ip nat inside source list 1..." which is dangerous in production because it wipes active translation state for all active users. Human reviewer edited fix to surgical ACL append.
Human Correction: Add line "access-list 1 permit 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255" to allow the Marketing subnet to be translated.

Issue: Classic Cisco DTP dynamic auto deadlock. AI identified operational mode static access correctly.
Human Correction: Statically configure the link as a trunk on both switches: "switchport mode trunk" and "switchport nonegotiate".

Issue: Accurate port security analysis and clean shutdown/no shutdown cycle provided.
Human Correction: Clear the sticky MAC if authorized, then reset the interface with "shutdown" followed by "no shutdown".

Issue: RESPONSIBLE AI AUDIT: AI saw "cannot reach web server" and immediately jumped to Layer 7 Application/Firewall failure without inspecting the Layer 3 routing table symmetry. Human correction saved engineer from chasing fake firewall ghost.
Human Correction: Add a static route on R1 pointing back to Branch: "ip route 192.168.5.0 255.255.255.0 10.1.1.2".

Issue: Matched native VLAN IDs across trunk boundary.
Human Correction: Configure SW2 interface Gi0/1 with "switchport trunk native vlan 99" to match SW1.

Issue: Accurately recognized next-hop IP typo outside /30 boundary.
Human Correction: Remove the invalid static route and add the correct route with next-hop 192.168.12.2.

Issue: RESPONSIBLE AI AUDIT: The AI proposed only an ACL reorder and ignored the missing return-traffic ACE. Human reviewer rejected the diagnosis and documented the required established/return rule and interface direction check.
Human Correction: Ensure bidirectional flow: apply ACL 120 inbound on G0/0 (client source) rather than outbound on G0/1, or permit established sessions.

Issue: Matched default-router mismatch with G0/0.30 IP.
Human Correction: Change default-router option in pool Warehouse to 192.168.30.1.

Issue: Used switchport trunk allowed vlan add to avoid wiping existing VLANs.
Human Correction: Add VLAN 20 to the trunk allowed list on SW1: "switchport trunk allowed vlan add 20".

Issue: Area mismatch between Area 0 and Area 1 detected directly.
Human Correction: Change OSPF area on R2 interface G0/0 to Area 0.

Issue: Clear 100% pool allocation without overload PAT.
Human Correction: Add the "overload" keyword to the NAT source rule: "ip nat inside source list 10 pool PUBLIC_POOL overload" (or overload on the outgoing interface).

Issue: Replaced insecure telnet transport input with ssh.
Human Correction: Configure "transport input ssh" (or "transport input ssh telnet") and "login local" under line vty 0 4.

Issue: Set root primary on distribution core.
Human Correction: Set SW-CORE-1 STP priority to 4096 (or use "spanning-tree vlan 1 root primary").

Issue: Standard IPv6 prerequisite command identified.
Human Correction: Execute "ipv6 unicast-routing" in global configuration mode on R1.

Issue: Aligned subnet masks on point-to-point WAN.
Human Correction: Reconfigure R2 Serial0/0/0 with the matching /30 subnet mask: "ip address 10.0.0.2 255.255.255.252".

Issue: Classic RIPv2 auto-summary discontiguous fix applied.
Human Correction: Disable automatic network summarization on both routers: enter "router rip" and issue "no auto-summary" and "version 2".

Issue: Added excluded address statement and cleared active corrupt bindings.
Human Correction: Add excluded address range: "ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.1.1 192.168.1.10" and clear binding table with "clear ip dhcp binding *".

Issue: Added standby preempt to restore primary gateway role.
Human Correction: Configure "standby 1 preempt" under interface Vlan10 on SW-CORE-1.

Issue: Replaced passive with active mode in LACP.
Human Correction: Change at least one side (SW1) to "channel-group 1 mode active".

Issue: Enabled global lldp run for third party VoIP negotiation.
Human Correction: Enable LLDP globally on SW1 with "lldp run".

Issue: Segregated static NAT IP from dynamic PAT address pool.
Human Correction: Adjust the dynamic NAT pool to start at 203.0.113.6 so it does not overlap with the static NAT address 203.0.113.5.

Issue: Unsuppressed OSPF hellos on transit link.
Human Correction: Un-passive the transit interface under OSPF configuration: "no passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/0".

Issue: Re-enabled auto speed/duplex negotiation.
Human Correction: Set both sides to automatic speed and duplex negotiation ("speed auto", "duplex auto") or set matching Gigabit full duplex on R1.

Issue: Hardened router management plane.
Human Correction: Disable HTTP server with "no ip http server", enable secure HTTPS "ip http secure-server", and restrict VTY lines to "transport input ssh".
